relationships.subject: CALCA promoter hypomethylation
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, hypomethylation of the CALCA promoter, especially at CpG sites − 1461 and − 1415 within the CREB-binding region, has been linked to increased CGRP expression and clinical features of migraine

relationships.subject: TRPA1 promoter methylation
relationships.evidence_quote: Epigenetically, genome-wide analyses revealed that DNA methylation of the TRPA1 promoter inversely correlates with its expression and pain thresholds [45].

relationships.subject: TRPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: mediates the effects of many migraine triggers by promoting CGRP release and meningeal neuroinflammation [44]

key_findings: Review of DNA methylation, histone modification, ncRNA and m6A mechanisms in migraine, TTH and cluster headache.
Therapeutic epigenetic targets include HDAC6 inhibitors, valproate, miR-155 inhibition and METTL3 inhibitors (preclinical).
